Puush is not only a screenshot program, but it can also store any other file (providing your account has the data quota to do so). Not only this, but Gyazo is not automatically a direct link to the screenshot. Puush, when you upload it, automatically copies the direct link to the file to your clipboard. This means that if I upload an image, I can just paste it into Voat, reddit, or anywhere I want to embed the image with just Ctrl+V. This is also true for any other thing it's possible to embed - such as MP3's and videos.
